name: express-boilerplate
description: Production-grade multi-tenant SaaS API boilerplate on Express 5 + TypeScript, mirroring the next-boilerplate module set.

layers.router: Express routing layer — one file per scope/module under router/. router/index.ts is the proxy router that rewrites /system/* and /tenant/:tenantId/*.
layers.modules_express: Express binding layer — middlewares (*.middleware.ts) and service extensions (*.service.express.ts) that touch Request / Response. Imports modules/* + Express.
layers.modules: Framework-agnostic business logic — services, DTOs, entities, types, enums, messages. No express, no Request/Response, no next/*, no react.

conventions.architecture: Two layers (plus router/), strict one-way dependency: router/ -> modules_express/ -> modules/. modules/ NEVER imports modules_express/ or router/.
conventions.scopes: Two URL scopes: system (super-admin, no tenant) at /system/... and tenant (per-tenant) at /tenant/:tenantId/.... router/index.ts rewrites incoming URLs based on host (TENANCY_MODE=domain) or path prefix (TENANCY_MODE=path).
conventions.auth: JWT (httpOnly cookies + Bearer header), OTP, TOTP, SAML, OAuth (via auth_sso), WebAuthn/Passkeys (user_security). Sessions: user_session. Impersonation: auth_impersonation, always audited. Middleware: modules_express/auth/auth.middleware.ts (factory: AuthMiddleware(role)).
conventions.testing: Jest + supertest. Tests colocated as *.test.ts beside the file under test. Run `npm test` (see package.json).
conventions.security: Read SECURITY.md for the full threat model. Path alias is the single `@/*` -> `./*`. Multi-tenant data isolation enforced by per-tenant TypeORM DataSource (modules/db). Tenant-scoped routers use Router({ mergeParams: true }) so req.params.tenantId is available downstream.

modules.name: ai
modules.description: Multi-provider AI service supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Handles chat completions, embeddings, streaming, usage tracking, and rate limiting.

modules.name: api_doc
modules.description: UI-only module for rendering interactive API documentation pages. Displays OpenAPI-style operation details, parameters, responses, and code samples. No backend service.

modules.name: api_key
modules.description: Manages API keys for tenant authentication. Generates, validates, and hashes keys with scopes and expiration tracking.

modules.name: audit_log
modules.description: Immutable event logging for system and tenant-level actions. Records actor, action, resource, metadata, IP, and user agent. Supports querying with pagination.

modules.name: auth
modules.description: Core authentication: login, registration, email verification, password management, OTP, and TOTP/2FA. Uses bcrypt and Redis for token TTLs.

modules.name: auth_impersonation
modules.description: Enables admins and super-admins to impersonate other users for testing and support. Validates role hierarchy, creates tracked sessions, and logs all impersonation actions to the audit log.

modules.name: auth_saml
modules.description: SAML 2.0 SSO per-tenant module.

modules.name: auth_sso
modules.description: OAuth2 SSO integration with 11 providers. Handles auth URL generation, callback processing, token management, automatic user creation/linking, and account management.

modules.name: coupon
modules.description: Coupon / promo code system for subscription plans and payments.

modules.name: limiter
modules.description: Framework-agnostic rate limiting servisleri.

modules.name: logger
modules.description: Winston tabanlı framework-agnostic logger servisi.

modules.name: notification_inapp
modules.description: Real-time in-app notifications using Redis pub/sub. Stores up to 50 notifications per user, tracks read/unread status, and streams updates via SSE. Auto-triggers push notifications.

modules.name: notification_mail
modules.description: Multi-provider email service with BullMQ queue and 15+ pre-built EJS templates. Supports direct and queued sending.

modules.name: notification_push
modules.description: Web Push notifications using the Web Push API with VAPID keys. Manages browser subscriptions and sends push messages to users or roles.

modules.name: notification_sms
modules.description: Multi-provider SMS with BullMQ queue, region-based provider routing, phone number validation (libphonenumber), rate limiting, and country allowlists.

modules.name: Payment Module
modules.description: A multi-provider payment gateway module supporting Stripe, PayPal, and Iyzico with full TypeScript support and Zod validation.

modules.name: idempotency
modules.description: Redis tabanlı idempotency key yönetimi.

modules.name: setting
modules.description: System-wide key-value settings with Redis caching (10-min TTL). Aggregates and re-exports setting keys from all other modules.

modules.name: storage
modules.description: Multi-provider cloud storage abstraction. Unified S3-compatible API for upload (multipart or from URL), delete, and URL generation. Provider is selected from system settings.

modules.name: tenant
modules.description: Multi-tenant organization management. Creates, updates, deletes tenants. Auto-provisions a personal tenant for every new user.

modules.name: tenant_branding
modules.description: Per-tenant branding settings: colors, logos, favicon, custom CSS/JS, and auth wallpaper. Built on top of `tenant_setting`.

modules.name: tenant_domain
modules.description: Custom domain management with DNS verification (TXT or CNAME). Enforces domain limits, caches in Redis, supports primary domain designation and status tracking.

modules.name: tenant_export
modules.description: GDPR Article 20 (data portability) — allows a tenant OWNER to download all tenant data as a structured JSON file.

modules.name: tenant_invitation
modules.description: Tenant membership invitations via email token. Auto-accepts pending invitations when a new user registers with a matching email. Tracks status and expiration.

modules.name: tenant_member
modules.description: Tenant membership management with role-based access control. Enforces role hierarchy, prevents demoting the last owner, supports search by email, and soft deletion.

modules.name: tenant_session
modules.description: Tenant authentication and authorization for API routes and server actions. Validates tenant status and membership, checks role permissions, caches membership for 5 minutes.

modules.name: tenant_setting
modules.description: Per-tenant key-value settings mirroring the system settings structure. Redis-cached with 10-min TTL. Falls back to global system settings when a tenant-specific value is not set.

modules.name: tenant_subscription
modules.description: Manages subscription plans, plan features, and feature enforcement for tenants.

modules.name: tenant_usage
modules.description: Tracks per-tenant usage counters (API calls, AI tokens, storage bytes, email sends) by month. Counters are stored in Redis for low-latency O(1) increments and flushed to the `tenant_usage` PostgreSQL table by a background CRON job for durable reporting and plan-limit enforcement.

modules.name: user
modules.description: System user management: CRUD operations, password hashing with bcrypt, role-based access, and soft deletion.

modules.name: user_agent
modules.description: User-Agent string parsing and geo-location lookup. Detects OS, browser, device type via regex patterns. Uses ip-api.com for geo-location with local IP filtering.

modules.name: user_preferences
modules.description: User UI/UX preferences: theme, language, timezone, date/time formats, notification channels, and week start day.

modules.name: user_profile
modules.description: User profile information: name, biography, profile picture, header image, and platform-based social links.

modules.name: user_security
modules.description: User security and MFA management. Tracks OTP methods, TOTP secret, backup codes, last login metadata, failed attempts with auto-lockout, and WebAuthn passkeys.

modules.name: user_session
modules.description: Session management with access/refresh token lifecycle. Supports device fingerprinting, multi-session tracking, impersonation metadata, and OTP verification flags.

modules.name: user_social_account
modules.description: External OAuth account linking. Links and unlinks social provider accounts, manages access/refresh tokens, and prevents duplicate account linking across users.

modules.name: Webhook Module
modules.description: Outgoing webhook system. Tenant admins configure HTTP endpoints and subscribe to events. When an event fires, the system signs and delivers a JSON payload to all matching endpoints.
